therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Adoptive transfer of ex vivo cytokine-activated NK cells with enhanced memory-like properties
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced NK cell-mediated anti-leukemic cytotoxicity and immune surveillance
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML) or myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Complete remission rate (CR/CRi) in Phase II

results.effect_size: CR/CRi rate: 0/7 (0%) in ALT-803 cohort, 3/9 (33%) in IL-2 cohort
subgroup_findings: IL-2 cohort showed higher response rate than ALT-803 cohort
results.dose_information: Maximum tolerated dose: 1.0 x 10^7 cells/kg; Dose levels tested: 0.5 x 10^6/kg, 1.0 x 10^6/kg, 1.0 x 10^7/kg
